notes.title: v1.01 Patch Notes
notes.content:
v1.01 Patch Notes

Since our launch we have had valuable feedback and even some bugs spotted, so we have gone ahead and patched as many up as possible for you guys. Below you will see a list of all the fixes or updates we have gone ahead and pushed live.

Noteable addtions:
-Added Autosaving feature which occures after compltion of a mission.
-FAQ Updated.
-Menu button now directs you streight to Main Menu.
-Added enemy ships to boss mission
-When creating new ships, starting block will be placed above ground rather than inside it.

Fixes:
-Fixed inconsitant loading of saves
-Fixed Twitter menu button directing to an old twitter account
-Fixed issues with NPC sound spatial blends (3D)
-Fixed Audio sliders not changing NPC volumes
-Fixed Grass block not showing correctly on NPC Trader UI


If you find any form of bugs, please visit the bug report disccussion or visit our discord.

notes.title: Colonies End Is live!
notes.content:
[h1][b][u]We are live![/u][/b][/h1]

Hello!
The last couple of months have been very busy in Raw Orange Studios. We were working on Bringing together all the major features we promised 12 months ago, which we are proud to say we are bringing to you today! Some of you have participated on our beta tests, and we want to shoutout to you guys for helping us out leading up to this day.

But the work does not stop here, oh no. As we are in early access we plan to keep working on bringing you some extra goodies in the next few weeks, so keep your eyes peeled!

So if you havn't already come join us in playing Colonies End to build, survive and explore in this crazy bizzare world we have created for you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35942230/e8ef47e11e62bcabe768b628305bde509df56732.png[/img]

notes.title: Exciting update for CE demo!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce our final major update for the games demo, we are now in the stages of preparing the game for commercial release ːsteamhappyː!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35942230/2c3e13c5b304c2dc8604d138035e60d5df7c4f3c.png[/img]
In this major final update for the demo we have fixed and added the following:


-Fixed various npc issues
-Added functionality to bounce block
-Can now drink from water sources to replenish thirst
-Fixed various ui interaction issues
-Fixed more ui scaling issues fixed 
-Fixed mission skip bug in first mission	
-Added more translations and translation cool down timer
-Melee attack npc's when they close (right-click)
-Fixed Odin helper npc going through walls
-Alien npc's now interactable (trading, missions, hints, etc)
-Added bounce pads and bounce block functionality 
-Added ladder and ladder blocks functionality
-Added oxygen block functionality
-Added food and water stats that now decline gradually
-Added consumable water, food and health objects across map
-Redone the menu to make it nicer looking
-Added sounds to many npc's
-Added clicking noises on more ui interaction
-More crafting blocks available in game world
-Other smaller changes and fixes too
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35942230/c644cbccc022873528e1ef8ac4e6ba6e835aedab.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35942230/24273f929eae0e6aad1c8f0ba6bcf3dbdb5be17e.png[/img]
On behalf of all the team at Raw Orange Studios we hope you enjoy this demo update and look forward to showing you more of our full game in the coming months!

notes.title: The Demo is Here!
notes.content:
[u][b][h1]We Did It![/h1][/b][/u]

We finally are able to say that as of right now, you can go ahead and grab a free copy of the demo for Colonies End via the steam store page. Alongside the demo launch, we have also launched an IndieGoGo campaign that will hopefully help us in bringing all the features alive for the full release. If you wish to donate and support us in making Colonies End the best it can be you can follow the link below: [url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/colonies-end-an-open-world-sandbox-space-game]LINK[/url]

We already have a playable demo to download but with a successful campaign Colonies End will offer:
[list]
[*]Space-age combat with jetpacks, bounce pads, lasers and more!
[*]Explore a strange world comprised of six-dimensional realms.
[*]Build exciting spaceships and space colonies with 6 tech tiers.
[*]Uncover the mysteries of the Desecrators and the lost expedition! 
[*]Scavenge for resources to stay alive in the world’s unforgiving dimensions. 
[*]Find creatures ranging from the common pig to the uncommon alien trader. With creatures [*]also ranging from close ally to deadly foe. 
[/list]

Thanks again to all that have and are supporting us through development of Colonies End. It means so much to us that we have your support. Keep an eye out for further announcements soon as we will have some big updates coming your way.
